answer: Farming becomes an ivory bet on surviving 91 epochs of grading, and every harbor settlement recomputes the cipher schedule, so an attacker who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 15 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 91 epochs rather than arriving at once. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
